{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("Columns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("dtypes:\n", df.dtypes)
print("Missing values:\n", df.isnull().sum())
print("Unique values in channel:\n", df['channel'].value_counts())
print("Unique values in customer_segment:\n", df['customer_segment'].value_counts())
print("Unique values in status:\n", df['status'].value_counts())
print("Revenue example:", df['revenue'].head(5).tolist())
print("Customer_age example:", df['customer_age'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("Number of -1 in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA order sample:", qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue']].head())

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded_orders))
print("Refunded order sample:", refunded_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue']].head())

# Note: revenue is string with commas
# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
# First, verify the format
print("Revenue sample with commas:", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())"}
